question: What’s the nearest gallery on the way from Wildlife West Nature Park, Edgewood, NM toward City of Santa Fe Firefighters Museum, Santa Fe, NM?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-106.202309 35.071827)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-105.971491 35.6661)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'gallery'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-106.202309 35.071827)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-106.202309 35.071827)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Wildlife West Nature Park, Edgewood, NM

[3].display_name: City of Santa Fe Firefighters Museum, Santa Fe, NM

poi.poi_name: City of Santa Fe Firefighters Museum
